findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 63 requests to 10 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 2.9 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 1.3 MB (44%) came from third-party domains, 1.1 MB of it from services classified as tracking (59 requests).

7 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), chartbeat.com (Chartbeat, analytics), chartbeat.net (Chartbeat, analytics), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising).
1 cookies were set by third-party domains (22 cookies in total).
